turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I passed my test ages ago but I still hate merging onto the motorway. My hands literally sweat.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's really common, and fixable. The key is matching the speed of the traffic before you merge, so use the whole slip road to accelerate.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I tend to slow down because I'm scared.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's the instinct, but it makes merging harder. Going too slowly means the gap you need is much bigger.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And the blind spot terrifies me.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Check your mirror early, then a quick look over your shoulder. Signal clearly so people know what you're doing, most drivers will make room.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Great idea. Early on a Sunday morning is perfect. A couple of calm runs builds a lot of confidence.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or I could book a refresher lesson.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Also very smart. An instructor can spot little habits you don't notice.
